name: codebase-navigator-prompt
body:
The distributed `codebase-navigator` agent prompt file `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md` (product source embedded via `include_str!` and installed by `apg init` into `~/.config/opencode/agents/`). It carries the per-task implementation cadence (its "Implementation flow" section) and, for the navigator's unguarded-main-git requirement, its `permissions` array's `shell`-action git rules. The granted git rules are `git status *`, `git diff *`, `git log *`, `git branch --show-current`, `git worktree list *`, and `git rebase *` (worktree-onto-main sync, run inside the worktree). The grant set excludes `git merge`, `git checkout`, `git switch`, the blanket `git branch *` (which admits ref-writing `-f`/`-D`/`-m`), and unrestricted `git worktree *`. Because `git diff *`/`git log *` admit `--output=<file>` (an arbitrary-file write, including inside the main checkout), the template states that `--output=<file>` is FORBIDDEN on every granted git verb and that diff/log output goes to stdout only. The body states main is integrated only via `apg project merge`.

Deliberately a NARROW owner, distinct from the broad `solution.component.navigator-prompt-guidance`: `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.coverage_check` maps coverage to this one file. Product source in `solution.container.opencode-suite`; the repo's own `.opencode/agents/**` are consumer artifacts.

implemented-by: `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`.
